name: plugin.r_editor_bridge
description: R editor tooling bridge integrating languageserver LSP 3.17, jgd C-level graphics streaming, and session watcher reflection
author: REditorSupport Bridge Forge

entrypoints.name: r_inspect_session
entrypoints.description: Inspect active R runtime session state, working directory, loaded packages, and symbols

parameters.name: working_dir
parameters.description: Current working directory of R session

parameters.name: loaded_packages
parameters.description: List of loaded package namespace names

parameters.name: global_symbols
parameters.description: List of variable and function identifiers in .GlobalEnv

entrypoints.name: r_parse_diagnostics
entrypoints.description: Parse and normalize raw LSP and lintr diagnostic messages into structured items

parameters.name: raw_diagnostics
parameters.description: Raw list of diagnostic dictionaries from LSP or lintr

entrypoints.name: r_stream_plot
entrypoints.description: Process and serialize an R graphics device (jgd) display-list event packet

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Plot width in pixels or points

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Plot height in pixels or points

parameters.name: payload_size
parameters.description: Size of serialized payload in bytes

entrypoints.name: r_validate_config
entrypoints.description: Validate R Language Server configuration parameters against operational boundaries

parameters.name: server_args
parameters.description: Arguments passed to R language server

parameters.name: debounce_ms
parameters.description: Debounce delay in ms before triggering AST lint

parameters.name: max_payload_mb
parameters.description: Maximum allowed payload size in MB
